payload.rationale: Fix hard-gate id_integrity failures by (1) replacing architecture option risk free-text with existing K* risk IDs from the risk_register and (2) correcting DEC6 evidence pointer so entity_id=CNS1 points to the constraint object (not a /text leaf). Additionally, resolve key consistency blockers without adding new IDs by updating AT2/AT3 to align with milestone scope and to explicitly exercise K3/XSS mitigations, and clarifying DEC4’s disable-vs-sanitize security posture wording.

patch.value: Run the build on a representative notes folder. Inspect the output directory contents and open the site via static hosting or a local static file server (recommended for local preview; file:// may break some JS behavior depending on implementation).
Build completes successfully; output contains only static assets (HTML/CSS/JS/media); the generated pages are browsable without any server-side application/runtime (i.e., no backend).

Prepare notes covering headings, lists, code blocks, blockquotes, links, images, and tables per the selected Markdown flavor. Include at least: (a) a note containing raw HTML/script-like payloads and event-handler attributes, and (b) links/images using unsafe URL schemes (e.g., javascript:). Build the site and visually compare rendered HTML output to expected formatting and verify unsafe constructs are not rendered/executed (sanitized/removed) and unsafe schemes are blocked.

All tested Markdown elements render correctly and preserve structure and formatting; raw HTML is disabled or sanitized per policy; unsafe URL schemes are blocked such that no script executes and rendered output does not contain unsafe links.

Default-deny: disable raw HTML in Markdown by default, and block unsafe URL schemes (e.g., javascript:) in links/images. If HTML support is required, allow only via explicit opt-in with sanitization enabled and documented risk.
